sentence: This project studies how pregnancy changes the pelvic floor muscles to prepare them for vaginal childbirth, using computational and experimental methods.
This project builds a computational and experimental framework that models behavior as a system linking neuronal activities, body movements and social relations in animals.
This project tries to find out how the immune system chooses what targets to make antibodies against and how long those antibodies last.
This project studies how a protein that binds RNA in male germ cells helps build ribosomes and whether abnormal ribosome assembly causes some male infertility.
This project studies how inherited gene variants affect the risk and poor outcomes of Langerhans cell histiocytosis.
This project tries to find out how the activity of molecules that present lipid antigens is controlled in monocyte-derived dendritic cells.
This project studies what physical conditions let a protein in Salmonella bend the membrane to form outer membrane vesicles.
This project studies how the human immune system protects children and adults from Salmonella and Shigella infections, using human infection and vaccination models.
This project builds DNA nanoparticles that propel themselves with an enzyme to break up biofilm and deliver antibiotics that kill bacteria.
This project builds a catalog of somatic variation in healthy human tissues using several kinds of sequencing.
This project builds a method that uses an enzyme called CasX to change a gene in stem cells so that they resist HIV infection.
This project tries to find out which platelet proteins carry the sugars that define blood types and how this affects platelet function.
This project studies how genes and physical health affect the shape and growth of brain perivascular spaces in youth from 9 to 12 years.
This project builds a way to barcode individual nematodes by randomly labeling cells so that each one's aging can be followed.
This project studies the genes of individuals and their families with Mendelian disease whose cause current clinical genomics tests have not found.
This project offers laboratory services that help cancer researchers plan clinical trial studies and run customized assays on patient samples.
This project offers imaging, flow cytometry and single-cell sequencing services for research on digestive disease.
This project tries to build cell culture or mouse models of the precursor lesion of testicular cancer using stem cells.
This project studies how the immune system responds to influenza vaccination and infection, looking at antibodies and human immune organoids.
This project builds a sensing system that uses millimeter-wave technology and AI on an autonomous robot to detect ticks in natural environments.
